about_the_game:
Master the spells and command the dead in tactical wizard brawls. Team up with friends for chaotic 2v2 and 3v3 battles, or prove your skill in intense 1v1 duels. With fully destructible terrain, no two matches are ever the same. 

CARVE YOUR PATH TO VICTORY

Every spell leaves its mark, literally. The terrain is 100% destructible. Tunnel underground to set up a surprise attack, blast away the ground beneath your enemy, or create a defensive wall out of the earth. If you can think of it, you can probably blow it up. 

CHOOSE YOUR SORCERER

Master one of three unique schools of magic, each offering deep strategic choices and a vastly different path to victory.

  • The Fire Breather: A specialist in raw, explosive area-of-effect damage. Perfect for players who like to make a big, fiery statement and watch the world burn.

  • The Necromancer: A master of minions and curses. Why fight your own battles when you can raise an army of skeletons to wear your enemies down?

  • The Druid: A conduit of nature's raw power. Command the earth to rise as Nature Golems, strike your foes with crackling lightning, and summon ferocious wild animals to overwhelm anyone who stands in your way.

MULTIPLE WAYS TO BATTLE Go head-to-head in a classic 1v1 duel to prove who's best, or team up with friends for tactical 2v2 and chaotic 3v3 battles where coordination and combos are key to victory.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED Think you have the perfect shot lined up? Think again. A fireball might crack open a spider nest, unleashing a swarm of angry critters that will attack anyone nearby—including you. Using the interactive environment is key to turning the tide of battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: This is a turn-based PvP game that combines classic artillery tactics with modern spellcasting. Your goal is simple: be the last wizard (or team) standing.
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
